title: Episode About the Tenth Sikh Guru

blocks.text: Continuing the explanation, the poet says the Khalsa Panth was never hidden after its creation; it was formed openly by the Satguru and could not remain concealed once it had taken its own shape. (1, 6)

The Mughal empire may have seemed vast, yet its commanders, populations, and informants failed to grasp in time how widely the Sikhs had spread, whether through ignorance, misreading, or political blindness. (2–5)

The answer given is that the Khalsa was born for visible struggle: Singhs were armed from the beginning, marked by khande-di-pahul, steel, and martial bearing, and therefore the Panth announced itself publicly rather than surviving as a hidden sect. (7–8)
